title: Robot Does Garba in Mumbai Ahead of Navratri 2026, Video Goes Viral
key_facts: A video shows a humanoid robot performing Garba, a traditional Gujarati dance, at a pre-Navratri event in Mumbai.
The video was shared on Instagram by Prashant Chosaliya and has gone viral.
Navratri, with nine days of Garba and Dandiya celebrations, begins on 11 October 2026.
Viewers reacted with amusement; the article does not name the robot's maker or the event.
quote_evidence: A humanoid robot has hit the dance floor in Mumbai, giving the traditional Gujarati dance a futuristic twist ahead of Navratri 2026.
Dubbed 'Robotbhai Garbawale', the dancing robot has caught the internet's attention.
why_it_matters_hint: A light cultural story of a robot joining a festival tradition.
notes: One outlet; maker and venue not named. Video not seen.
